profile_text.body:
Beautiful.ai is a presentation software company founded in 2016. Its platform is described as an AI presentation tool built for enterprise teams, with the stated goal of keeping every deck on-brand and consistent across an organization. The site says it serves use cases from sales to strategy, offering over 300 auto-aligning Smart Slide layouts, shared brand themes, and data visualization tools including charts, graphs, timelines, and diagrams.

The company's primary AI product is a guided workflow called Create with AI, which it describes as context-aware and designed to keep users in control through outline editing before slide generation, local iteration on individual slides, and compatibility with inputs ranging from short prompts to full outlines, including those drafted in ChatGPT. Beautiful.ai positions Create with AI as distinct from one-shot AI generators by making iteration built-in throughout the process rather than treating generation as a single step. The site cites customer examples including Paciolan, Cvent, and IDC, each of which it says cut presentation design time by 75% or achieved significant reductions in production time after adopting the platform.

The held facts confirm Beautiful.ai maintains a tracked product profile on theworldofai.org under the Slides and Presentations category, with presentation generation as its noted function. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
